paragraphs: This is a completely free template for quickly setting up a new Conference or Meetup website, powered by Nuxt Studio under the hood as a Git-based CMS. Everything included - the template itself, all dependencies, and the CMS - is available at no cost. It features visual editors, live previews directly in your browser, and an intuitive interface, making it effortless to manage content without touching code. Once set up, it is the perfect solution for non-technical users, as all content updates can be handled visually through the browser interface.
While the template and tools are free, hosting and deployment costs are not included and depend on your chosen provider.
features: ⚡ Modern Stack: Nuxt 4, Vue 3, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript.
🎨 Customizable: Fully themeable via Nuxt UI and configuration files - your colors, your style!
📝 Git-Based CMS Editing: Nuxt Studio ready for visual editing, live preview, and content updates directly in the browser.
